title: Rain could end as flakes Friday
headline: Rain showers Thursday night could turn to snow showers before dawn as colder air wraps in behind the storm, with little or no snow accumulation. That puts the chance of first flakes Friday at 50%, up from 25% last update; the RRFS is the snowiest model at 44%, the European the least at 4.7%. The ridges are likelier to whiten than town.
